what.title: What is cirrhosis? Causes, how common it is and early symptoms
what.description: What cirrhosis is, its many causes, how many people live with it worldwide, why most do not know, early symptoms and person-first language.

liver.title: What the liver does: lobule, blood supply and signs of liver failure
liver.description: Animated liver lobule: portal vein and artery, zones, stellate and Kupffer cells, albumin, bile, glucose, ammonia to urea, and what liver failure changes.

fibrosis.title: Liver fibrosis to cirrhosis: stellate cells, METAVIR, regression
fibrosis.description: How liver injury becomes scar: stellate-cell activation, collagen, capillarisation, nodules, METAVIR F0–F4, progression rates and evidence fibrosis regresses.

alcohol.title: Alcohol-related liver disease: fatty liver to cirrhosis, and stopping
alcohol.description: How heavy drinking moves from fatty liver to hepatitis and cirrhosis, risk by drinks a day in women and men, steroids, Lille, early transplant and abstinence.

masld.title: MASLD and MASH: fatty liver disease, fibrosis stages and treatment
masld.description: MASLD, MASH and MetALD explained: global prevalence, why fibrosis stage predicts outcomes, weight-loss results, bariatric surgery, resmetirom and semaglutide.

hepatitis.title: Hepatitis B and C cirrhosis: viral load, antivirals and DAA cure
hepatitis.description: Animated, cited guide to hepatitis B and C as causes of cirrhosis: REVEAL-HBV viral load risk, tenofovir regression, DAA cure rates and HCC risk after SVR.

othercauses.title: Other causes of cirrhosis: haemochromatosis, Wilson, AIH, PBC, PSC
othercauses.description: Haemochromatosis, Wilson disease, alpha-1 antitrypsin, autoimmune hepatitis, PBC, PSC, drug injury and Fontan liver: key tests, treatments and inheritance.

tests.title: Cirrhosis blood tests, ultrasound and liver biopsy explained
tests.description: How to read ALT, AST, ALP, bilirubin, albumin, INR and platelets as patterns in cirrhosis, what ultrasound shows, and biopsy roles and risks.

noninvasive.title: FIB-4 calculator and FibroScan kPa bands for liver fibrosis
noninvasive.description: A teaching FIB-4 calculator with published cut-offs, Baveno VII rule of five for FibroScan kPa, and APRI, ELF and MR elastography accuracy.

scores.title: Child-Pugh and MELD scores: MELD-Na and MELD 3.0 calculator
scores.description: Child-Pugh items and classes A, B and C explained, with a teaching calculator for MELD, MELD-Na and MELD 3.0 using the published formulas.

portal.title: Portal hypertension and varices: HVPG, bleeding and treatment
portal.description: Animated HVPG gauge from 5 to 12 mmHg, how varices form and bleed, the variceal bleed bundle, PREDESCI, carvedilol and the Baveno VII endoscopy rule.

ascites.title: Ascites in cirrhosis: diuretics, paracentesis, SBP and HRS explained
ascites.description: How fluid builds up in cirrhosis, with EASL diuretic steps, albumin after paracentesis, TIPS, the SBP neutrophil threshold and terlipressin for HRS.

encephalopathy.title: Hepatic encephalopathy: ammonia, West Haven grades and treatment
encephalopathy.description: Hepatic encephalopathy animated: how ammonia reaches the brain, West Haven grades, triggers, lactulose and rifaximin trials, and the animal naming test.

hcc.title: Liver cancer surveillance in cirrhosis: ultrasound, AFP and BCLC
hcc.description: Why people with cirrhosis get an ultrasound and AFP every 6 months: HCC risk, early-detection sensitivity, BCLC stages, treatments and a Milan checker.

course.title: Cirrhosis stages: compensated, decompensated, ACLF and survival
course.description: The stages of cirrhosis from compensated to decompensated and ACLF, with 5-year mortality by stage, Baveno VII definitions and recompensation.

transplant.title: Liver transplant: referral, MELD waiting list and survival
transplant.description: The liver transplant journey animated: referral and MELD, evaluation, waiting-list outcomes, deceased and living donors, tacrolimus and US survival figures.

nutrition.title: Cirrhosis nutrition: late evening snack, sarcopenia, safer medicines
nutrition.description: Why cirrhosis behaves like accelerated starvation, EASL protein and energy targets, the late evening snack, sarcopenia, frailty and paracetamol limits.

nursing.title: Cirrhosis nursing care: paracentesis, variceal bleed, NCLEX scenarios
nursing.description: A ward shift in decompensated cirrhosis: daily weights, asterixis, lactulose stool counts, paracentesis checks, variceal bleed priorities and CIWA-Ar.

living.title: Living with cirrhosis: daily weights, red flags and palliative care
living.description: A week with cirrhosis: medicines, daily weights, late snack, 6-monthly scans, symptoms, urgent red flags, a self-check log, carers and palliative care.

frontier.title: Cirrhosis research: MASH drugs, statins, cell therapy and trials
frontier.description: Evidence-labelled pipeline of cirrhosis research: resmetirom, semaglutide, FGF21 drugs, statin trials, macrophage therapy, machine perfusion and NCT trials.

history.title: History of cirrhosis: Laennec to MELD, liver transplant and HCV cure
history.description: A timeline of cirrhosis from Laennec in 1819 through Starzl's transplants, Child–Pugh, TIPS, MELD and the hepatitis C cure to MASLD and resmetirom.

review.title: Cirrhosis flashcards and mnemonics: Child–Pugh, MELD, varices, HE
review.description: 88 cited cirrhosis flashcards by part, ten memory aids, and an animated ABCDE walk through Child–Pugh points and classes, for students and patients.

quiz.title: Cirrhosis quiz: 98 questions with cited explanations
quiz.description: Multiple-choice cirrhosis questions on causes, FIB-4, elastography, MELD, varices, ascites, SBP, encephalopathy, liver cancer and transplant, each explained.

glossary.title: Cirrhosis glossary: 150+ liver terms from ACLF to West Haven
glossary.description: Searchable cirrhosis glossary: MASLD, MetALD, HVPG, SAAG, SBP, MELD 3.0, LI-RADS, stellate cells and more, each cited and linked to its module.

sources.title: Cirrhosis Companion sources: guidelines, trials and drug labels
sources.description: Every reference behind the Cirrhosis Companion, from AASLD, EASL and Baveno VII guidance to trials and FDA labels, filterable by research area.
